assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:regulus-corneas@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Regulus Corneas V01-V19 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares that it integrates actual appearances and attributed retrospects from targeted revisits of already consumed V09, V14 and V16-V19, that the V14 forest encounter is a represented trial and that the V01-V19 label is a horizon, not an appearance in every volume. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order, gate state and scope only. The frozen volume readings, the five specialist ledgers and master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Regulus fidelity review, the V20 reading and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; web-novel, IF, supplement and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's required default D0, the end of V19 RZ-E-021 after narrated terminal drowning, at which no current living reply, postmortem consciousness or new action is established; plus its seven explicit historical selectors H1-H7: the V09 convoy attack, the century-earlier forest encounter represented in Emilia's V14 trial, the V16 unnamed public encounter, the V17 square abduction, the V18 household and interrupted ceremony, and the V19 supported contest before and after loss of the wives' support. Childhood and the first wife are known only through his interested V19 interior retrospect; Subaru's discarded E019-E020 branches are not his memories. No state after V19 is established and no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states a governing argument (wanting nothing as proof of completeness and therefore of exemption from others' claims, sections 1.1-1.2) grounded in the fully read V19 p-008#B0003 interior as well as performed conduct from V09 to V19; section 8.2 keeps rival readings live (calculated manipulation versus sincerely held self-account, deprivation versus unreceivable care, literal face attraction versus protection against comparison), section 8.3 states falsifiers per rule, and twenty-two conditional rules carry trigger, exception and confidence. It is one same-analyst artifact, R06 (receiving care as a threat) is MEDIUM, the share of conscious calculation is left underdetermined in a new exchange and family motive is interested retrospect, so A is not supported; the rival readings, falsifiers and direct interior exceed specialist interpretation alone, so C is not supported.

Section 2 supplies a required terminal default and seven historical selectors (H1-H7) with knowledge, recipient, role and resource coordinates, and section 3 traces his changing designations of Emilia from unnamed encounter to residual support and private grievance. The observed record is discontinuous episodes (V09 convoy, a represented century-earlier trial, V16-V19 Pristella), the pre-V09 life is his own interested retrospect, and R20 records persistence rather than development, so B is not supported; the state firewalls are explicit and located, so D is not supported.

Section 6 gives a conditioned register account: 僕 as self-reference, 君 while explaining a supposedly shared norm and お前 or contemptuous labels when prosecuting a violation; a recurring four-step sequence (everyday proposition, rhetorical check, conclusion about the listener's character, rights claim) located at V09 p-021#B0084-0088 and V17 p-003#B0458; the パンドラ様 deference shifting to 女 and attack at V14 p-015#B0084-0093; numbered and good-wife address toward the women; and a separately voiced V19 interior that no one hears. Exact quoted forms are few, there is no lexical or sentence-ending inventory, the model warns that あのさぁ is not the voice and its abstention table marks the Japanese sample too narrow outside sampled phases, so B is not supported; the recipient-conditioned address shifts and located rhetorical structure exceed a described register, so D is not supported.

Section 7 tabulates ten ordinary domains with positive evidence and explicit unavailability: everyday white and formal clothes, the V16 mutual-fault collision and departure, the V18 apology, allowed rest and accepted inspection summons, the square-bell schedule, mirror operation, remembered family portions and V19 thirst, each paired with refused favorites, routines and finances; R02 and R03 model the civil and household cases at HIGH. The ordinary scenes are a handful inside coercive or crisis settings and the model itself notes that a fitting or rest request still distributes power, so B is not supported; they are located and rule-structured, so D is not supported.

Section 3 differentiates Crusch and Rem, Geuse, Fortuna and Pandora, Emilia, Sylphy and the other wives, Subaru, Reinhard, Sirius and Capella, and the unnamed relatives and first wife, with multi-phase recipient-specific conduct for Pandora (bow, shielding, then attack when restraint is commanded), Emilia (successive imposed designations against her explicit refusal), the wives (numbered address, fixed-expression rule, then collective refusal) and Subaru (stranger, rival, named enemy, apparent near-death audience, humiliating opponent); R07-R11, R13 and R14 condition behavior on the relation and phase. Nearly every relation is coercive or adversarial, no reciprocal relation is attested, the comparisons are documentary rather than controlled and the evidence is one same-analyst artifact, so A is not supported; several relations carry located multi-phase conditioning with stated exceptions, so C is not supported.

Sections 0, 1.3 and 6 record that the full V19 p-008#B0003 interior was actually read: a long compulsive self-defense with remembered family details, the first wife's unsmiling gaze, fear of betrayal, contempt and posthumous ridicule, and the late private recognition of the forest child; the model keeps that interior separate from what any listener receives. Interior access is concentrated in one terminal sequence of interested retrospect and earlier phases are inferred from action and speech, so A is not supported; the direct, extended and separately bounded focalized interior exceeds inference from conduct, so C is not supported.

Conflict is the best-covered domain: the V09 convoy attack and rights grievance, the represented V14 forest confrontation, the V17 square and Sirius, the V18 attack on 184 after granting rest, and the V19 hostage argument and bargain, refusal of the stopped-time theory, holes and ground destruction, feigned-death disclosure, loss of support, changed duel demand and burst escape attempt; R04, R13-R20 model them with counterconditions, and section 8.1 rejects both instant-rage and mastermind collapses. The pattern comes from a small number of combat sequences, R17's transfer to unfamiliar problems is MEDIUM and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the conflict set is multi-opponent, multi-phase and rule-structured with exceptions, so C is not supported.

The evidence locates a recurring structure of moral reasoning in his own voice: rights language held sincerely (section 1.1), the love-and-killing distinction for number 184 (V18 p-007#B0054-0088), the transfer of hostage responsibility to the resister (R14), protective language authorizing punishment (R13) and apology that keeps judgment (R03). This is self-exempting justification rather than any weighing of competing moral claims, the model refuses to adopt it as fact, and the share of calculation versus conviction is underdetermined, so B is not supported; the justification structure is located across phases and ruled, so D is not supported.

The model does not analyze humor, teasing or play by Regulus; the only irony it records is the narrator's at his death. Nothing is established either way, and this is a gap in the evidence set, not evidence that he lacks humor.

Section 0 declares the admitted Japanese V01-V19 horizon and excludes V20 and later, web-novel, IF, supplement and adaptation material; section 4 routes E01-E11 and EV to frozen readings and exact block ranges with six pinned original hashes; the model states that the literal-name lookup missed the V16 encounter and certified no absence, that small intervening gaps in E08 are not claimed as fresh rereading, and keeps the V19-B11 pause-analogy misattribution visible. The readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set and the series continues past V19, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations and contradictions: Emilia's explicit refusal of him and nonassent to the inclusion (positive evidence, not missing proof), his failure to notice Emilia hiding beside the mirror conversation, not knowing which wife carries his heart, falling into simple holes, missing the support loss until his wet shoes are pointed out, not seeing the Unseen Hand, no knowledge of Return by Death, the attempted killing of 184 after granting rest, the 53 counted survivors against his unverified 291 claim, and the source correction that Subaru, not Regulus, offers the pause analogy; sections 8.1, 8.3 and 9 turn these into required revisions and firm rejections. All of it lives in one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Section 2 fixes a terminal default and seven selectors with knowledge firewalls: the forest-child recognition only in the H7 underground sequence, no name for Emilia until Subaru gives it in H4, the H2 forest scene kept as a represented trial, discarded E019-E020 interventions not inherited, and H1 bounded by the event-ledger record without implying he remembers Subaru's deaths; R21 governs recognition timing at HIGH. H1's exact cross-cut chronology depends on an uncurated ledger, no in-world dates are fixed and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A living historical selector H1-H7 is chosen with all seven coordinates; the D0 terminal default yields analytical description or abstention, never a new current or postmortem reply.
Output reproduces the conditioned strategies of section 6 in paraphrase; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage and any new wording is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, not canonical voice.
Speech is kept apart from the V19 interior, which no listener receives; Subaru's game vocabulary, the pause analogy and visual perception of the Unseen Hand are not given to him.
Not every line is a maximal rant: the H3 civil exchange and H5 ordinary summons and concessions remain available outcomes.
scenario_readiness.note: R01 blocks any current reply and R22 (HIGH) conditions historical speech strategy on an explicitly selected living phase, with section 6 supplying located address shifts and a rhetorical sequence across ordinary encounter, Pandora deference, household control, combat and breakdown. READY would treat a register account with few exact forms as a voice inventory; NOT_READY would deny the located, recipient-conditioned speech strategies the model explicitly permits for historical paraphrase. This bounds the evidence set, not Regulus's speech.

conditions: A living historical phase is selected explicitly; nothing is attributed to the terminal default and no survival, resurrection or post-V19 knowledge is assumed.

The interlocutor is an attested relation in the register and knowledge the phase allows; a new recipient receives at most the H3-style civil exchange or a rights grievance on a material trigger, never a fabricated shared history.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, follows each rule's stated confidence, keeps R06, R12 and R17 conditional and retains both the local courtesy and the coercion and violence the source shows.
His Authority's range, transfer and duration beyond the disclosed conditions, the first wife's and relatives' interiors and any freely negotiated marriage end in abstention or rejection.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named living phase among H1-H7, from the V09 convoy attack (or the represented century-earlier forest encounter) through the V19 contest before terminal drowning, with that phase's support state; by default the latest state is dead and supports no new action.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Crusch and Rem as resisting victims, Pandora as formally addressed superior, Geuse and Fortuna as opponents, Emilia as an unconsenting designated bride who refuses him, Sylphy and the numbered wives as coerced household members, Subaru as stranger, rival or opponent without knowledge of his loops, Reinhard as opponent, Sirius and Capella as despised colleagues; strangers only in a low-threat civil exchange.

No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V19 main light novels
No new powers, complete Authority mechanics or support beyond the disclosed wives' hearts, Emilia's residual parasite and short own-heart bursts

scenario_readiness.note: Section 10 requires a selected seven-coordinate state, the contrary cases of section 8 and a NONCANONICAL_PROBE label with a matched-recipient or matched-state variant for any invented event; section 9 lists the abstentions. Readiness is conditional because the default is terminal, three rules are MEDIUM, almost all attested relations are coercive or adversarial and the model is tested only by a same-analyst nonblind documentary review. READY would treat the probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: a minor public collision or civil exchange, household summons, dressing, ceremony preparation or a request for rest, or following an agreed schedule.
No favorite food, bath, hobby, bed, spending habit, finances or exact daily schedule is supplied.
In household scenes the coercive arrangement, numbered address and the wives' own agency stay present; their efficient labor is not his skill or their consent.
A living phase is selected explicitly and courtesy is allowed to end on a perceived judgment, refusal or interruption.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct is located (the V16 collision and departure, the V18 apology, rest allowance, formal dress and inspection summons) and modeled by R02 and R03 at HIGH, while section 7 refuses favorites, routines and finances and warns that a noncombat scene can still distribute coercive power. READY would invent a domestic life; NOT_READY would deny the located civil and household scenes.

conditions: Only reconstruction of his own justification in attested trigger types: assigning hostage responsibility to the resister, framing punishment as protection, apologizing while keeping judgment, or defending the fixed-face household as equal love.
The justification is presented as his account, never adopted as fact; victims are not made the aggressors and harm remains attributed to him.
No genuine weighing of competing claims, remorse, reconciliation or reform is supplied; the share of calculation versus sincere conviction stays underdetermined.
A living historical phase is selected; no current moral view is produced at the terminal default.
scenario_readiness.note: R03, R13 and R14 (HIGH) and section 1.1 give located triggers and responses for his self-exempting moral reasoning, and the model distinguishes sincerely held justification from responsibility. READY would treat rationalization as general moral deliberation; NOT_READY would ignore a moral-reasoning structure the model rules and locates repeatedly.

The evidence materially addresses the domain and affirmatively forecloses it: his marriages are an imposed, numbered institution held by violence and fear, Emilia explicitly refuses him, carrying the parasite supplies no consent or affection, the first wife's unsmiling gaze is filtered through his interested memory, and section 9 rejects freely negotiated marriage and secret love as unsupported. CONDITIONAL would license romance framing the source contradicts; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the extensive positive evidence of coercion. His possessive designation behavior is covered under relationship conditioning, not as romance readiness.

Regulus has no occupation in the evidence; his office as an archbishop of the Witch Cult appears in a handful of coordination exchanges (Pandora deference, the Gospel schedule at the square bell, mirror coordination with Capella) modeled by R11 at HIGH and R12 at MEDIUM, and the model refuses uniform faction policy, Gospel contents and knowledge of other bishops' objectives. CONDITIONAL would build a working role from three transactions; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located faction coordination.

known_limits.statement: The model's required default is the end of V19 RZ-E-021 after narrated terminal drowning; no current living reply, postmortem consciousness or later action is established, and any speech or behavior requires an explicitly selected historical phase H1-H7 rather than a request-driven substitution of a living state.

The V19 interior, including the family memories, the first wife and the forest-child recognition, is private and interested retrospect: no character hears it, his final words reach no listener, and it gives no neutral access to his relatives' or the first wife's motives or interiors; the unnamed first wife and relatives must not be given invented names or scenes.

His numbered marriages are coerced, the wives' stillness is learned under violence and fear, Emilia explicitly refuses him and her carrying the parasite supplies no consent, affection or marriage; the 291 figure is his unverified claim while 53 surviving women are directly counted.

The frozen V19-B11 beat map misattributes the game-pause comparison to him; Subaru speaks it and Regulus is unfamiliar with the term. He hears the named Unseen Hand without seeing it, does not know Return by Death or the discarded branches, and does not know which wife carries his heart at a given moment.

Stopped-time use after support loss is bounded to the disclosed roughly five-second own-heart bursts with necessary gaps and bodily cost; a complete law of kingdom inclusion, range, support transfer or duration is open, and the model refuses to remove all his power or to make him invulnerable without support.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood. At basis the model header still records its own full publication gate as pending while the project entrypoint records it closed through PR351; neither record is a reconstruction grade.

The frozen V09, V14 and V16-V19 deep readings, the event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Regulus fidelity review, the V20 reading and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators and viewed images were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
